description: ERC-4626 inspired vault contract for autonomous yield management

functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Initialize the vault contract (can only be called once)
notes: Requires valid signature from deployer to prevent front-running
Can only be called once - subsequent calls will panic

functions.name: deposit
functions.description: Deposit USDC into the vault and receive vault shares
functions.security: Protects against inflation attacks with minimum deposit and non-zero mint guard

functions.name: withdraw
functions.description: Withdraw USDC from the vault by burning shares
constraints: user must have sufficient shares to cover withdrawal

functions.name: withdraw_all
functions.description: Withdraw all user funds by burning all shares

functions.name: rebalance
functions.description: AI agent rebalances funds between yield protocols
functions.security: Only authorized agent keypair can call this function
notes: Performs slippage check against min_out parameter

functions.name: auto_compound
functions.description: Withdraw accrued yield from the current protocol and immediately reinvest it to compound growth
functions.security: Only authorized agent keypair can call this function
constraints: current protocol must be a configured yield protocol
notes: Single-transaction withdraw of accrued yield and re-deposit into the same protocol
Updates TotalAssets to reflect compounded amount
Performs slippage check against min_out parameter

functions.name: pause
functions.description: Pause deposits and withdrawals (emergency function)

functions.name: unpause
functions.description: Resume normal operations

functions.name: emergency_pause
functions.description: Emergency pause without signature verification (for critical situations)

functions.name: set_tvl_cap
functions.description: Set maximum total value locked in vault

functions.name: set_user_deposit_cap
functions.description: Set maximum deposit per user

functions.name: set_caps
functions.description: Set both user deposit cap and TVL cap in single atomic transaction
notes: Preferred method over calling set_tvl_cap and set_user_deposit_cap separately

functions.name: set_limits
functions.description: DEPRECATED: Use set_caps or set_deposit_limits instead
notes: This function is deprecated and may be removed in future versions

functions.name: set_deposit_limits
functions.description: Set minimum and maximum per-transaction deposit limits

functions.name: set_rebalance_cooldown
functions.description: Set minimum ledgers between rebalance and auto_compound calls (0 = no cooldown)

functions.name: get_rebalance_cooldown
functions.description: Get the minimum ledger interval between rebalance and auto_compound calls

functions.name: get_last_rebalance_ledger
functions.description: Get the ledger sequence of the last successful rebalance or auto_compound

functions.name: set_approval_ttl
functions.description: Set the ledger TTL for token approvals (alias for set_blend_approval_ttl)

functions.name: get_approval_ttl
functions.description: Get the configured token approval TTL in ledgers

functions.name: get_tvl_cap
functions.description: Get current TVL cap

functions.name: get_user_deposit_cap
functions.description: Get current per-user deposit cap

functions.name: get_min_deposit
functions.description: Get minimum deposit amount per transaction

functions.name: get_max_deposit
functions.description: Get maximum deposit amount per transaction

functions.name: set_user_strategy
functions.description: Set a user's strategy choice

functions.name: get_user_strategy
functions.description: Get a user's strategy choice

functions.name: update_agent
functions.description: Update the authorized AI agent address

functions.name: confirm_agent_update
functions.description: Confirm a proposed agent update after the timelock has elapsed

functions.name: cancel_agent_update
functions.description: Cancel a pending proposed agent update

functions.name: get_pending_agent_update
functions.description: Get the pending proposed agent address and effective ledger

functions.name: set_blend_pool
functions.description: Set Blend pool address for yield deployment

functions.name: set_dex_pool
functions.description: Set DEX pool address for liquidity deployment

functions.name: set_blend_approval_ttl
functions.description: Set the ledger TTL for Blend token approvals

functions.name: transfer_ownership
functions.description: Initiate two-step ownership transfer (new owner must call accept_ownership)
notes: Two-step process prevents accidental ownership loss
New owner must accept within timeframe

functions.name: accept_ownership
functions.description: Accept ownership transfer (must be called by pending owner)

functions.name: cancel_ownership_transfer
functions.description: Cancel a pending ownership transfer

functions.name: get_pending_owner
functions.description: Get pending owner address if transfer in progress

functions.name: update_total_assets
functions.description: Update total assets to reflect realized yield or loss

functions.name: schedule_upgrade
functions.description: Schedule a contract WASM code upgrade by hash, initiating the timelock window

functions.name: execute_upgrade
functions.description: Execute a scheduled contract WASM code upgrade after the timelock has elapsed

functions.name: cancel_upgrade
functions.description: Cancel a pending contract code upgrade proposal

functions.name: get_pending_upgrade
functions.description: Get the pending proposed upgrade WASM hash and effective ledger

functions.name: get_balance
functions.description: Get user's USDC balance

functions.name: get_total_deposits
functions.description: Get total USDC deposited in vault

functions.name: get_total_assets
functions.description: Get total vault assets (principal + yield accumulated)

functions.name: get_total_shares
functions.description: Get total vault shares outstanding

functions.name: get_shares
functions.description: Get user's vault shares

functions.name: touch_user_ttl
functions.description: Extend persistent TTL for user shares entry

functions.name: get_user_info
functions.description: Get complete user information and statistics

functions.name: preview_deposit_to_shares
functions.description: Preview shares minted for asset amount (floor)

functions.name: preview_shares_to_assets
functions.description: Preview assets returned for share amount (floor)

functions.name: preview_withdraw
functions.description: Preview shares burned for withdrawal amount (ceil)

functions.name: convert_to_shares
functions.description: Convert asset amount to shares (floor)

functions.name: convert_to_assets
functions.description: Convert share amount to assets (floor)

functions.name: get_current_protocol

functions.name: get_blend_pool
functions.description: Get Blend pool address if configured

functions.name: get_dex_pool
functions.description: Get DEX pool address if configured

functions.name: get_blend_approval_ttl

functions.name: get_exchange_rate
functions.description: Get current exchange rate (assets per share * 10^7)

functions.name: get_idle_balance
functions.description: Get the vault's idle USDC balance (funds held in the vault, not deployed to any protocol)

functions.name: get_deployed_assets
functions.description: Get the amount of USDC currently deployed to an external yield protocol

functions.name: get_asset_breakdown
functions.description: Get the vault's asset breakdown as (idle, deployed) in a single call

VaultError::NoAssetsToWithdraw.description: Vault has no assets to withdraw.

VaultError::NoAssetsToReturn.description: Vault has no assets to return.

VaultError::NoSharesToBurn.description: Vault has no shares to burn.

VaultError::OnlyOwnerCanPause.description: Caller is not allowed to pause.

VaultError::UserDepositCapCannotBeNegati.description: User deposit cap cannot be negative.

VaultError::TvlCapBelowUserDepositCap.description: TVL cap must be greater than or equal to user deposit cap.

VaultError::MinimumDepositTooLow.description: Minimum deposit is below the allowed floor.

VaultError::MaximumDepositBelowMinimum.description: Maximum deposit is below the minimum.

VaultError::OnlyOwnerCanConfigurePool.description: Caller is not allowed to configure a protocol pool.

VaultError::CallerIsNotPendingOwner.description: Caller is not the pending owner (or no pending ownership transfer exists).

VaultError::OnlyAgentCanUpdateTotalAsset.description: Caller is not allowed to update total assets.

VaultError::TotalAssetsDecreaseNotAllowe.description: Total assets decrease requires explicit allowance.

VaultError::DecreaseExceedsMaximumAllowe.description: Total assets decrease exceeds configured maximum bps.

VaultError::InsufficientBalanceForAssets.description: Vault balance is insufficient for reported assets.

VaultError::BelowMinimumDeposit.description: Deposit is below the configured minimum.

VaultError::MinOutNotMet.description: A protocol leg returned less than min_out.

VaultError::RebalanceCooldownActive.description: Rebalance called before the configured cooldown has elapsed.

VaultError::ApprovalTtlTooLow.description: Approval TTL is below the allowed floor.

VaultError::ApprovalTtlTooHigh.description: Approval TTL is above the allowed ceiling.

VaultError::DexPoolNotConfigured.description: DEX liquidity pool is not configured.

VaultError::InvalidStrategy.description: Strategy must be one of "conservative", "balanced", or "growth".

VaultError::TimelockAlreadyPending.description: A timelocked proposal (agent update or upgrade) is already pending.  Shared by the agent timelock (#317) and the upgrade timelock (#316). The SDK caps `#[contracterror]` enums at 50 cases, so both two-step flows reuse one set of generic timelock error codes rather than each defining their own.

VaultError::NoTimelockPending.description: No timelocked proposal exists to confirm/execute or cancel.

VaultError::TimelockNotExpired.description: The timelock delay has not yet elapsed.

VaultError::ShareConversionOverflow.description: Share conversion intermediate product overflow (assets * total_shares).

VaultError::ShareToAssetConversionOverfl.description: Share conversion intermediate product overflow (shares * total_assets).

VaultError::ExchangeRateOverflow.description: Exchange rate intermediate product overflow (total_assets * scalar).

VaultError::DeployerCannotBeZeroAddress.description: Deployer address supplied to `initialize` is the zero address.

VaultError::OwnerCannotBeZeroAddress.description: Owner address supplied to `initialize` is the zero address.

VaultError::AgentCannotBeZeroAddress.description: Agent address supplied to `initialize` is the zero address.

VaultError::UsdcTokenCannotBeZeroAddress.description: USDC token address supplied to `initialize` is the zero address.

VaultError::MaximumDepositExceedsCeiling.description: Maximum per-transaction deposit exceeds the absolute configured ceiling.

PausedError.description: Vault is paused, deposits and withdrawals disabled

UnauthorizedAgentError.description: Only authorized AI agent can call this function

UnauthorizedOwnerError.description: Only contract owner can call this function

InsufficientBalanceError.description: User has insufficient balance for withdrawal

InvalidAmountError.description: Amount is invalid (zero, negative, or outside limits)

SlippageError.description: Output less than minimum expected (slippage protection)
